同名旧路由不能直接覆盖；删除公开路由前须先停用。: An existing route with the same name cannot be overwritten. Disable a public route before deleting it.
模型名称不能超过 128 个字符: Model names must not exceed 128 characters
先检查候选差异，再迁移为公开路由。原配置会归档，可在记录中回滚。: Review candidate differences before migrating to public routes. Original configuration is archived for rollback.
预检加载失败，请重新预检。: Preflight failed to load. Refresh to retry.
将保留绑定账号和模型配置，关闭自动回退。旧候选配置归档后不再参与调度。: Keep the bound account and model configuration with automatic fallback off. Archived candidates will no longer participate in routing.
自动池中的其他账号: Other accounts in the automatic pool
回滚恢复原候选配置与编号；公开路由已修改或删除时，系统会拒绝覆盖。: Rollback restores original candidates and IDs. Edited or deleted public routes cannot be overwritten.
迁移记录加载失败，请重新预检。: Migration history failed to load. Refresh to retry.
将恢复归档的候选配置，移除本次创建的公开路由。使用记录和账号配置保持不变。: Restore archived candidates and remove the public route created by this migration. Usage records and account settings are preserved.
操作失败，请重新预检后重试: Operation failed. Refresh preflight before retrying.
仅可删除已停用且未被路由或在途请求使用的账号，历史用量记录保留。: Disable the account and remove route references before deleting. Active requests block deletion; usage history is retained.
仅本人可用，最多 5 条；通过模型前缀区分平台模型。: Only you can use these channels. Up to 5; model prefixes distinguish them from platform models.
例如 my：模型将以 my/模型名 提供，调用时自动去掉前缀。: For example, my exposes models as my/model-name. The prefix is removed upstream.
前缀不能包含空白或反斜杠: Prefix cannot contain whitespace or backslashes
已保存；自动探测未验证成功，可稍后重试: Saved; automatic verification was unsuccessful. You can retry later.
已复制，健康状态从未验证开始: Copied with health status reset to unverified
每行一个，或用逗号分隔。发现结果需手动加入，不会覆盖已配置模型。: One per line or comma-separated. Add discovered models explicitly; existing models are preserved.
添加自己的上游账号，通过模型前缀调用。: Add your upstream account and call models using its prefix.
自定义请求头必须是 JSON 对象: Custom headers must be a JSON object
请先编辑并停用账号: Edit and disable the account first
例如 {\"X-Tenant\": \"team\"}。不能覆盖鉴权头。: For example {"X-Tenant": "team"}. Authentication headers cannot be overridden.
统一管理上下文窗口和输出上限。默认值不代表已验证的模型能力。: Manage context and output limits. Defaults do not represent verified model capabilities.
删除后使用目标模型档案或默认能力值。: The target model profile or defaults will apply after deletion.
手动添加模型能力，或导入已核验的能力目录。: Add a model profile or import a verified capability catalog.
覆盖值留空时使用导入目录；无目录时采用 128000 / 8192 默认值。: Leave overrides blank to use the catalog; without a catalog, defaults are 128000 / 8192.
留空恢复目录值或默认值。: Leave blank to restore the catalog value or default.
只更新目录值，不覆盖人工配置和启停状态。不会访问外部网站。: Updates catalog values while preserving overrides and enabled status. No external website is contacted.
目录内容必须是 JSON 数组: Catalog must be a JSON array
重复发送相同请求，按网关实际用量记录比较缓存结果。— 表示未知，不代表零。: Repeat identical requests and compare recorded gateway usage. — means unknown, not zero.
仅删除验证记录，不删除网关用量日志。: Deletes the verification record; gateway usage logs remain.
将使用所选令牌调用已配置的上游，消耗实际额度。每轮发送相同提示词，最多 5 轮；: Uses the selected token to call configured upstreams and consume quota. Sends the same prompt up to 5 times; the prompt is saved with the record.
仅使用本人的有效 chat 令牌，沿用模型权限和配额。: Uses your valid chat token with its model permissions and quotas.
没有可用令牌，请先在访问与授权中创建。: No available token. Create one in Access & Authorization first.
正在顺序调用网关，请勿重复提交。完成后显示逐轮结果。: Calling the gateway sequentially. Do not resubmit. Results appear when complete.
逐轮缓存结果；统计来源为网关已结算的请求日志。: Per-round results from settled gateway request logs.
测试期间切换了账号或上游模型，命中率不代表同一缓存池: Account or upstream model changed; this ratio spans different cache pools.
上游缓存用量未完整上报，无法计算完整命中率: Upstream cache usage is incomplete; a complete hit ratio is unavailable.
配置网关使用的独立搜索与网页抓取服务。保存配置不会发起搜索。: Configure independent search and page extraction. Saving does not run a search.
未配置账号级代理，遵循平台出站策略: No service proxy; platform egress policy applies
留空保留当前密钥；填写新值则替换，不回显已保存的密钥。: Leave blank to keep the key; enter a new value to replace it. Saved keys are never displayed.
清除后不会回退使用环境变量中的密钥。: Clearing also prevents fallback to the environment key.
可选 HTTP(S) 代理地址，留空保留当前值；凭证加密保存。: Optional HTTP(S) proxy. Leave blank to keep it; credentials are stored encrypted.
清除后仍遵循部署者配置的平台出站策略。: Platform egress settings still apply after clearing.
删除控制台覆盖值，重新使用服务端环境变量；当前未保存内容也会清除。: Removes console overrides and uses server environment values. Unsaved form changes are also discarded.
将发起一次真实搜索，可能消耗搜索服务额度。未保存的表单内容不参与检查。: Runs one real search and may consume provider credits. Unsaved form values are not used.
搜索模型，或输入模型 ID: Search or enter a model ID
先获取模型，也可以输入模型 ID 手动添加: Fetch models first, or enter a model ID to add manually
点击星标设为默认: Star a model to set the default
勾选支持的模型，星标选择默认模型。: Select supported models and star the default.
输入上游提供的模型 ID，每行一个或用逗号分隔: Enter upstream model IDs, separated by newlines or commas
无需先获取模型。添加后自动选中，重复 ID 会合并；可在下拉列表中设置默认模型。: Model discovery is optional. Added models are selected and duplicate IDs are merged. Set the default in the dropdown.
模型 ID 不能超过 128 个字符: Model IDs must not exceed 128 characters
最多选择 50 个模型，请减少后再添加: Select up to 50 models. Reduce the list before adding.
暂无模型，请获取模型或手动添加: No models yet. Fetch models or add them manually.
所选期间有异常请求，请查看日志排查: Errors occurred in this period. Check the request logs.
缓存命中率按已报告读取缓存的请求加权计算：缓存读取 Token / 对应输入 T: Cache hit rate is weighted over requests reporting cache reads: cached input tokens divided by their input tokens.
按请求执行时的上游快照分组，最多展示 100 项；缺失快照单独归类。: Grouped by upstream snapshots at execution time, up to 100 groups. Missing snapshots are grouped separately.
部分数据不可用，无法确认整体状态: Some data is unavailable; overall status cannot be confirmed.
当前可查看的指标中没有待处理问题: No issues in the available metrics
候选账号异常或冷却中: Candidates are unhealthy or cooling down
每日 Token 配额（0 不额外限制）: Daily token quota (0 adds no limit)
每分钟请求上限（0 不额外限制）: Requests per minute (0 adds no limit)
默认沿用当前用户的额度和并发限制；也可选择令牌验证其模型权限和配额。: Uses your quota and concurrency limits by default; select a token to verify its model access and quota.
使用当前用户或所选令牌调用上游，消耗实际额度。每轮发送相同提示词，最多 5 轮；: Calls the upstream as the current user or selected token and consumes actual quota. Sends the same prompt for up to 5 rounds; the prompt is saved with the verification record.
